description: agentwatch coach: health check after each tool call, and a one-time block of a call that repeats a HIGH loop (PreToolUse; AGENTWATCH_LOOP_BREAKER=off disables it). Notification and Stop send a desktop/webhook alert when the session needs you or has finished, only after `agentwatch notify on`; they run async, print nothing and never block a stop. `; exit 0` keeps the hook a silent no-op (no hook-error notice) when agentwatch is not on PATH; it works in both Git Bash and PowerShell.
